headline: Sensex gains 400 points as IT stocks rally and foreign funds flow in; BSE receives positive rating.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty IT index jumped over 2% as IT stocks rallied in early trade.
Renewed foreign fund inflows provided significant support to the market.
HSBC initiated coverage on BSE with a positive outlook and strong growth prospects.
The market opened in the green despite concerns over fresh US tariff threats.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 are trading higher, with the Sensex gaining nearly 400 points in early sessions.
Tata Trusts has moved the Bombay High Court to challenge the reappointment of N. Chandrasekaran at Tata Sons.
Gold and silver prices saw a sharp rebound, with gold jumping by Rs 2,700.
MCX and KFin Technologies emerged as top gainers in the small and mid-cap segments.
summary: The Indian market opened higher on November 26, led by a 2.4% jump in the IT index and steady foreign fund inflows. BSE shares gained attention after HSBC initiated coverage with a strong growth forecast, while MCX and KFin Tech led mid-cap gains. Investors are also monitoring a legal challenge by Tata Trusts against the leadership at Tata Sons.
